meta.reset: Every sequence starts from EA_PROTO.resetSession() — the console's own canonical reset (D9). The harness does not keep a second copy of the state list.
meta.how_to_replay: The prototype loads proto-replay.js: ▸ replay journeys drives every sequence and compares each step against after{} and frame; ▸ check golden frames re-renders every recorded state. A step fails on one differing character.
meta.how_to_read_from_pytest: Each frames-*.json state carries setup{}, size[w,h], invariants{} and frame (exact text, rows joined by \n). A Textual snapshot test asserts render(setup) == frame; journeys assert the step-by-step after{} projection, including the notification rack depth.
meta.ordering: Replay the journeys FIRST, then the frames: the frames must still match in a session the journeys left deep in state, which is what proves the reset rather than the renderer.
meta.projection: route · overlay · sel · subjId · conn · bucket · back_depth · toasts · mark — the marker is projected because a cursor drawn in colour is invisible to a text comparison.
